author: CC
prose: test_transitions' three demo-gate teeth write three fixture tickets and a validations/ directory into the live commons tickets store and unlink them after. A proof writing into the real tickets store is a defect even serially. The teeth should stage their fixtures in a scratch store through the one patch point, with a red-first tooth that reds if any of the three fixtures appears in the real store during the run. It has to be built before e56a68e651c2, which runs verdict instruments three at a time and would let test_v2_migration's glob-then-read race these fixtures.
